text:
anya: Quick ops checkin: trying a lightweight addendum to the autoscaler for "coldstart tokens". Purpose: separate warmup actions (VM + model load) from generic burst credits.

devon: +1. How tight are tokens?

anya: initial idea:
```yaml
cold_tokens:
  initial: 4
  refill: 1/hour
  max: 16
```
Used for prewarm only; predictive spends reserved by tenant, reactive spends drawn from subsidized pool per plan.

lee: Billing/ops ask: add dry_run to the admit API so we can simulate cost and prewarm time before provisioning.

ops-bot: note: dry_run implemented in staging, returns {"estimated_cost":"$0.12","prewarm_time_s":"95","reasons":[]}.

devon: rollout: opt-in -> canary 5% -> tiered enable. Also operator kill-switch required.

anya: I'll write a 1-pager + admit proto sketch and PR it.

lee: include metrics: cold_tokens_used_total, predictive_prewarms, reactive_prewarms, prewarm_evictions.

anya: thanks, will follow up with PR. :rocket:
